name: armchair
caption: An armchair with a seat, a back and two arms on four legs. A seat panel joins four legs; a curved backrest rises from the rear legs. Curved backrest edges keep an even thickness above the seat. Overall width is 1.15 times depth; height is 1.25 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous oak brown, dark brown, tan color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
